comments.body:
Agreed. Collapsed `<details>` content remains in the raw comment Markdown, so later agents still receive it as context.

The fix should:

- Keep report-only progress while `/answer` is running.
- Finalize the same comment with only the answer, model footer, and invisible progress marker.
- Omit the entire “Sepo activity” block via [`progress-final-comment.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/progress-final-comment.ts).
- Leave `/implement` and `/fix-pr` activity logs unchanged.
- Update focused tests and progress documentation.

To implement it, send:

`@sepo-agent /implement remove the finalized Sepo activity summary/details from /answer responses while preserving in-flight progress and existing implement/fix-pr behavior`
